description: After a duplicate-email error, editing the email leaves the error text but moves it from under Email to the bottom of the form, and the 'Open <name>' button disappears.
expected: Error stays under Email with its Open button, or clears once the email changes.
actual: Message jumps below Notes (generic alert position) and no longer relates to a field; stays until the next Save.
suggested_fix: Clear the duplicate error when Email changes, or keep it attached to Email.
